items.name: theme
items.title: Nelumbo Theme
items.description: Nelumbo foundations: neutral color roles with an accent palette (brand blue, pure neutrals), surfaces, elevation, spring motion, type roles and tactile utilities.

theme.shadow-e1: 0 1px 2px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 7%, transparent), 0 1px 3px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 4%, transparent)
theme.shadow-e2: 0 1px 2px 0 color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 6%, transparent), 0 4px 12px -2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 9%, transparent)
theme.shadow-e3: 0 2px 4px -1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 6%, transparent), 0 12px 28px -6px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 13%, transparent)
theme.shadow-e4: 0 4px 8px -2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 7%, transparent), 0 22px 44px -10px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 17%, transparent)
theme.shadow-e5: 0 8px 16px -4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 8%, transparent), 0 36px 72px -16px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow-color) 24%, transparent)

@utility tactile.transition: scale 727ms var(--ease-spring-bouncy), padding 727ms var(--ease-spring-bouncy), width 727ms var(--ease-spring-bouncy), box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-standard), background-color 200ms var(--ease-standard), border-color 200ms var(--ease-standard), border-radius 260ms var(--ease-spring), color 200ms var(--ease-standard)

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Material Symbols Rounded as a variable font: typed names, fill, weight, grade and optical size as CSS variables, plus a subset-URL helper.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Tactile button with tonal and elevated variants, spring press, shape morph and loading state. Drop-in superset of shadcn Button.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Standard, filled, tonal and outlined icon buttons. Toggle mode fills the glyph and morphs the shape on selection.

items.name: segmented-button
items.title: Segmented Button
items.description: Single or multi select connected options on Radix ToggleGroup; check mark slides in on selection.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Standard (pressed button widens, neighbors yield) and connected (small inner corners, selected rounds out) layouts for Nelumbo buttons.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: Main action plus a menu trigger; the trigger rounds out and the chevron turns while the menu is open.

items.name: fab
items.title: FAB
items.description: Floating action button in five color roles and three sizes; extended label animates in and out.

items.name: field-shell
items.title: Field Shell
items.description: Shared text field shell for Input and Textarea: filled or outlined container, CSS-only floating label, notched border, icons and help text.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with a floating label, filled (default) or outlined, in two sizes; leading icon, trailing slot, help and error text.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field matching Input; grows with its content and shows a character count with maxLength.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: shadcn-compatible Select on Radix whose trigger is a Nelumbo text field (filled or outlined, floating label, help and error text); the list drops from the field at full width with filled selection.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type-to-filter field (ARIA combobox) with accent-insensitive matching, groups, icons at either end, multiple selection as chips, nested options (cascading menus by default, or drill-in panels), async loading and forms. Also exports NestedSelect, a select-only version for nested options.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch on Radix Switch: the thumb grows and slides with a spring, optional check/cross icons, brand color and a small size.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox on Radix: the check draws itself in, indeterminate dash, 40px halo and hit area, brand and error colors.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio group on Radix: the dot springs in, 40px halo and hit area, brand and error colors.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Slider on Radix: thick track with a slim bar handle and gaps, value bubble, range, step marks, a large size with an inset icon, brand color.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn-compatible Card with elevated, filled and outlined surfaces, a small size, full-bleed or inset media, and interactive cards with hover, focus and a springy press.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Assist, suggestion, filter and input chips: 32px with the field radius, a check that slides in, removable values, and a chip group.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: shadcn-compatible Dialog on Radix: spring entrance over a blurred scrim, sizes, a hero icon that centers the header, and a scrolling body with edge hairlines.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: shadcn-compatible Sheet on Radix Dialog: four sides, a floating style, and bottom sheets with a drag handle and drag-to-dismiss.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: shadcn-compatible Popover on Radix: grows out of its trigger on a spring, with header, title and description slots.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: shadcn-compatible Dropdown Menu on Radix: 40px items with concentric corners, Material Symbols icons, filled radio selection, springy check, submenus and destructive items.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: shadcn-compatible Tooltip on Radix: plain labels with keyboard shortcuts, rich tooltips with a title, works with or without a provider.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: shadcn-compatible Tabs on Radix: pill and underline styles with one indicator that slides on a spring, icons that fill in, badges, full width, scrolling.

items.name: navigation-rail
items.title: Navigation Rail
items.description: Material 3 Expressive navigation rail: active pill grows from the center, icons fill in, badges, header for a menu button and FAB, footer, and an expanded mode.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: Snackbars on Radix Toast with a sonner-compatible API (toast, toast.success/error/warning/info/loading/promise, Toaster): one at a time with a queue, a single action, descriptions, in-place updates, swipe to dismiss.

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation Bar
items.description: Material 3 Expressive bottom navigation bar: stacked or inline items, active pill grows from the center, filled icons, badges, safe-area padding.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear and circular progress on Radix Progress: determinate with a gap and stop dot, indeterminate sweeps, flat or wavy (a travelling wave), brand color, two bar sizes.

items.name: loading-indicator
items.title: Loading Indicator
items.description: Material 3 Expressive loading indicator: a shape that springs through seven forms as it turns, plain or contained, brand color, any size. Pulses with reduced motion.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder for loading content with a soft sweeping shimmer (a pulse with reduced motion). Same API as shadcn's Skeleton.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar on Radix Avatar (shadcn API): image with initials fallback, auto palette tint from the name, five sizes, circle or rounded, status badge, overlapping groups with +N.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Label badge (shadcn variants plus brand, success, warning, info; dot and icon) and NotificationBadge: a dot or capped count that springs onto an icon, icon button or avatar.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Material 3 list: leading avatar or icon, overline, title, description, meta and trailing control; whole-row links and buttons with stretched targets; plain or segmented tiles; subheaders and dividers.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Material 3 calendar on react-day-picker (shadcn's props carry over): filled selection, outlined today, range bands, a year grid behind the title, sliding months, Intl month and weekday names.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: DatePicker (type a date in the locale's order, or pick from a docked calendar; min, max, disabled days, validation) and DateRangePicker (two months, presets, apply/cancel).

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: shadcn-compatible Accordion on Radix: plain or segmented tiles, leading icon and description on triggers, spring chevron, height-and-fade content animation, reduced-motion safe.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: shadcn-compatible inline Alert with tonal info, success, warning, destructive and brand variants, automatic icons, actions, animated dismiss and a full-width banner layout.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: shadcn-compatible Table in a rounded, scrollable container: soft header, faint row dividers, selected rows, comfortable or compact density and an optional sticky header.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: TanStack Table data table: sortable headers with aria-sort, row selection with select-all, search, column menu, bulk-action bar, pagination with rows per page, empty and loading states.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: TimePicker: type a time in the locale's format (12 or 24 hour), or pick from a docked Material 3 clock dial or list columns. Hour and minute chips, AM/PM, min, max, step, validation.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: shadcn-compatible InputOTP on input-otp: separate field-style slots (or connected), blinking caret, invalid and disabled states, paste support.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: shadcn-compatible Toggle on Radix: tonal on state with filled icon, outline variant, three sizes, tactile press.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: shadcn-compatible ToggleGroup: connected like the button group with the selected item morphing to a pill, or spaced; single or multiple.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: shadcn-compatible Breadcrumb: chevron separators, pill hover on links, ellipsis for collapsed levels.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: shadcn-compatible Pagination: tonal current page, labels that hide on phones, and a paginationRange helper for ellipses.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: shadcn-compatible ScrollArea on Radix: thin auto-hiding thumb that grows on hover, keyboard-focusable viewport, optional edge fades.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: shadcn-compatible Separator on Radix: faint line, inset, or space only.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: shadcn-compatible Command on cmdk: search field, grouped items with icons and keycap shortcuts, spacing instead of separators, loading and empty states, and a dialog for ⌘K.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: shadcn-compatible AlertDialog on Radix: Nelumbo dialog motion, optional icon tile that pops in, destructive variant, footer that stacks on phones.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: shadcn-compatible Collapsible on Radix with the accordion height-and-fade animation and an optional spring chevron.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: shadcn-compatible HoverCard on Radix: popover surface that springs out of the trigger side.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: shadcn-compatible Label on Radix in the label-lg type role; dims when its control is disabled, turns red when invalid.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: shadcn-compatible Form on react-hook-form: one label per control (FormLabel feeds Nelumbo fields their floating label), wired ids and descriptions, spring error messages, a shake on failed submit.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: shadcn-compatible Chart on Recharts in Material 3 Expressive, after Google's health app: a big readout that follows one point in focus (hover, click or arrow keys), pill bars with goal badges, dotted zone and goal lines, a right-hand value axis, inverse tooltips, pill labels, donuts with a growing active slice, dotted radar grids, radial bars on tonal tracks, stage lanes and progress rings. Every shadcn area, bar, line, pie, radar, radial and tooltip variant has a Material counterpart in the docs.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: shadcn-compatible Carousel on Embla plus Material 3 layouts: multi-browse and hero cards that resize as they scroll, uncontained, and dots that stretch into a pill.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: shadcn-compatible Resizable on react-resizable-panels: rounded tonal panels with a gap instead of a line, a grip that grows and turns primary while dragged.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: shadcn-compatible NavigationMenu on Radix: a tonal track with a pill that springs between triggers, a viewport that morphs size between panels, rich links on icon tiles, a featured card.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: shadcn-compatible Sidebar: no lines, a tonal pill that springs between items and into sub-menus, spring collapse to icons like the navigation rail, animated sub-menus, badges that become dots, mobile sheet.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Material 3 search: a pill search bar with a springing clear button, expanding into a docked search view (full screen on phones) with recents, filter chips and a highlight that springs between results.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: shadcn-compatible ContextMenu on Radix: springs open from the pointer, a raised highlight that slides between rows, keycap shortcuts, spacing instead of separators.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: shadcn-compatible Menubar on Radix: a tonal track with a raised segment that springs between open menus, sliding row highlight, keycap shortcuts.

items.name: app-bar
items.title: App Bars
items.description: Material 3 top app bar (small, center, medium, large; elevate, collapse with a settling spring, or hide on scroll) and bottom app bar (actions plus FAB, floating option, hide on scroll).

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: shadcn-compatible Field layout set: fieldsets, legends, descriptions and spring errors; FieldLabel feeds Nelumbo fields their floating label; choice cards with a tonal selected state.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: shadcn-compatible Item sharing List styles: segmented tile groups, icon tiles, outline as a ring, selected state, tactile when interactive.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: shadcn-compatible InputGroup that reads as one Nelumbo field: inline and block addons, text prefixes, keycap hints, tonal buttons, a chat composer layout.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: shadcn-compatible NativeSelect: a real select on the Nelumbo field shell, with floating label, sizes, invalid state and a dark native list.

items.name: fab-menu
items.title: FAB Menu
items.description: Material 3 Expressive FAB menu: the FAB shrinks into a close button while tonal action pills spring out in a stagger; full menu keyboard support, optional scrim.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Material 3 Expressive toolbars on Radix Toolbar: docked or floating, horizontal or vertical, standard, vibrant or brand; shape-morphing toggles, a paired FAB, collapse on scroll, overflow into a More menu.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: shadcn-compatible Kbd and KbdGroup: raised keycaps, an inverse look inside tooltips, and KbdShortcut that splits a shortcut into caps.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: shadcn-compatible Spinner: a breathing ring, or Nelumbo morphing shapes; announced as status, reduced-motion safe.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: shadcn-compatible Empty state: a large icon tile over softly fanned tiles, avatar media, no dashed border.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: shadcn-compatible AspectRatio on Radix.

items.name: residue
items.title: Residue
items.description: The tile the biology components are built on: a letter on a rounded tile, colored through one tone system (hue only; lightness and chroma come from the variant and theme), plus ResidueSequence with blocks, ruler, highlight and keyboard selection.

items.name: nucleotide
items.title: Nucleotide
items.description: DNA and RNA bases as tonal tiles and strands: Nelumbo, base-pair and purine/pyrimidine schemes plus IGV, Jalview, trace and Okabe-Ito redrawn at one lightness; complement strand, codon footers, inline or top rulers, selection; NucleotideChange for mutations (changed bases as a capsule, indels aligned with gaps); complement, translate and GC helpers.

items.name: amino-acid
items.title: Amino Acid
items.description: Protein residues as tonal tiles and sequences: side-chain and charge schemes plus hydrophobicity, Clustal X, Zappo, Taylor and Okabe-Ito redrawn at one lightness; three-letter notation, inline or top rulers, selection; AminoAcidChange draws a mutation as one connected shape (residue, position, new residue), titled in HGVS.

items.name: gene-model
items.title: Gene Model
items.description: A gene's transcripts as exons and introns: tall coding blocks and thinner UTRs joined with connected corners, dotted introns with strand chevrons, exon numbers in transcription order, compressed introns, genome or transcript orientation, isoform stacks with the canonical in color, variant lollipops with pill labels, and keyboard focus on exons, and protein domains mapped through the coding sequence onto the exons that encode them.

items.name: protein-domains
items.title: Protein Domains
items.description: A protein along its length: a thin backbone, domains as tall rounded blocks named inside where they fit, overlapping domains on lanes, a residue ruler, a legend, and variants as lollipops with pill labels stacked to avoid collisions.

items.name: plasmid-map
items.title: Plasmid Map
items.description: A circular plasmid map: thin backbone ring, features as rounded directional arcs on lanes, names along arcs or outside with leaders spread to avoid overlap, restriction sites as ticks, a ruler, a center readout of the feature in focus, keyboard and pointer focus, and a legend on narrow maps; uniqueSites finds single cutters.

items.name: sequence-alignment
items.title: Sequence Alignment
items.description: Aligned DNA or protein sequences as rows of connected residue tiles: gaps as thin lines, blocks that wrap to the width (or one scrolling row under a draggable identity overview, names held), column ruler, end positions, a feature and marker track, identity bars, a consensus row, per-sequence identity and sorting, color by residue, conservation or difference (with dots), and block selection by drag, keyboard, names or ruler that copies as aligned FASTA; alignmentConsensus, percentIdentity, alignmentSlice and toFasta helpers.

items.name: plate-map
items.title: Plate Map
items.description: A 6 to 1536-well microplate as an ARIA grid, as bare wells or the whole plate to scale (SBS footprint, true pitch, molded labels, a chamfered corner where notch puts it, drawn as a solid fill or an outline, with its front side and a scannable Code 128 barcode label underneath): wells by group or by value on a sequential or diverging scale, excluded wells, a hover card with lit headers, a legend, and rectangle, additive and line selection traced as one filleted outline; wellRange, parseWell, wellName, cellsOutline and code128 helpers.
